limitations: Negative cases and invalid-input guard-order tests demonstrate only the role and parish preconditions of four exposed SECURITY DEFINER functions. They do not exercise valid decrees, transitions, rollbacks after partial writes, concurrent mutations, or all 152 privileged RPCs. CI will validate this dated evidence offline, not replay live SQL.
